name: Ditto
description: Search and reuse approved product copy, follow your style guide, and edit and translate text.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Ditto in the browser. The connection acts as the Ditto user who signs in. Write tools start enabled and remain governed by Paperclip's action policies.
methods.label: Sign in with Ditto
warnings: A Ditto account in the workspace whose text and style guides agents should use. API keys require developer integrations on the Ditto plan.
Ditto delete tools cannot be undone, and linking text to a library component replaces each text item's developer ID. Set those actions to Ask first before agents run unattended.

capabilityProfile.label: Read and write
capabilityProfile.description: Read style guide rules and search product text, and create, edit and translate text, components, variants and style guides. Ditto delete tools cannot be undone, and linking text to a library component replaces each text item's developer ID. Set those actions to Ask first before agents run unattended.

methods.whenToUse: Use a Ditto workspace API key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: In Ditto, open Developers → API keys, create a key for Paperclip, and paste it below.
methods.label: Use an API key

credentialFields.label: Ditto API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Ditto API keys are not scoped: a key reaches all data in its workspace, including permanent deletes, and actions are attributed to the user who created the key. Create a separate key for Paperclip so it can be removed independently, and set delete and link actions to Ask first before agents run unattended. Paperclip cannot narrow an existing key.
